parts.zh: M：那都是些什么？你要做沙拉吗？
W：西班牙冷汤是一种来自西班牙的冷汤
M：不新鲜的面包？你说的应该是蘸汤吃的面包吧？
W：不是。面包会和其他所有食材一样被碾碎并搅拌进去
W：当然健康。正如我刚才说的

items.stem: What do we learn about gazpacho?

choices.text: It is a typical salad.
choices.zh: 它是一种典型的沙拉。

choices.text: It is a Spanish soup.
choices.zh: 它是一种西班牙汤。

choices.text: It is a weird vegetable.
choices.zh: 它是一种奇怪的蔬菜。

choices.text: It is a kind of spicy food.
choices.zh: 它是一种辛辣食物。

items.stem: For what purpose is stale bread mixed into gazpacho?

choices.text: To make it thicker.
choices.zh: 使它更浓稠。

choices.text: To make it more nutritious.
choices.zh: 使它更有营养。

choices.text: To add to its appeal.
choices.zh: 增加它的吸引力。

choices.text: To replace an ingredient.
choices.zh: 替代一种配料。

items.stem: Why does the woman think gazpacho is healthy?

choices.text: It contains very little fat.
choices.zh: 它含有极少的脂肪。

choices.text: It uses olive oil in cooking.
choices.zh: 它在烹饪中使用橄榄油。

choices.text: It uses no artificial additives.
choices.zh: 它不使用人工添加剂。

choices.text: It is mainly made of vegetables.
choices.zh: 它主要由蔬菜制成。

items.stem: What does the woman say about cured ham?

choices.text: It does not go stale for two years.
choices.zh: 它两年内不会变质。

choices.text: It takes no special skill to prepare.
choices.zh: 准备它不需要特殊技能。

choices.text: It comes from a special kind of pig.
choices.zh: 它来自一种特殊的猪。

choices.text: It is a delicacy blended with bread.
choices.zh: 它是一种与面包混合的美味佳肴。

items.stem: What does the woman think of table wines?

choices.text: They come in a great variety.
choices.zh: 它们种类繁多。

choices.text: They do not make decent gifts.
choices.zh: 它们不适合作为体面的礼物。

choices.text: They do not vary much in price.
choices.zh: 它们价格差异不大。

choices.text: They go well with Italian food.
choices.zh: 它们很适合搭配意大利菜。

items.stem: What is the price range of wine the man will consider?

choices.text: Around $150.
choices.zh: 150美元左右。

items.stem: Why does the woman recommend red wines?

choices.text: They are a healthy choice for elderly people.
choices.zh: 它们对老年人来说是健康的选择。

choices.text: They are especially popular among Italians.
choices.zh: 它们在意大利人中尤其受欢迎。

choices.text: They symbolize good health and longevity.
choices.zh: 它们象征健康和长寿。

choices.text: They go well with different kinds of food.
choices.zh: 它们适合搭配各种食物。

items.stem: What do we learn about the wine the man finally bought?

choices.text: It is a wine imported from California.
choices.zh: 这是一款从加利福尼亚进口的葡萄酒。

choices.text: It is less spicy than all other red wines.
choices.zh: 它比所有其他红葡萄酒都更不辛辣。

choices.text: It is far more expensive than he expected.
choices.zh: 它比他预期的要贵得多。

choices.text: It is Italy's most famous type of red wine.
choices.zh: 它是意大利最著名的红葡萄酒类型。

items.stem: What does the speaker say many people enjoy doing?

choices.text: Learning others' secrets.
choices.zh: 了解他人的秘密。

choices.text: Searching for information.
choices.zh: 搜索信息。

choices.text: Decoding secret messages.
choices.zh: 破译秘密信息。

choices.text: Spreading sensational news.
choices.zh: 传播耸人听闻的新闻。

items.stem: What do we learn about the Navajo code talkers?

choices.text: They helped the U.S. army in World War Ⅱ.
choices.zh: 他们在第二次世界大战中帮助了美国军队。

choices.text: They could write down spoken codes promptly.
choices.zh: 他们能够迅速写下口头密码。

choices.text: They were assigned to decode enemy messages.
choices.zh: 他们被指派破译敌方信息。

choices.text: They were good at breaking enemy secret codes.
choices.zh: 他们擅长破解敌方密码。

items.stem: What is the speaker mainly talking about?

choices.text: Important battles fought in the Pacific War.
choices.zh: 太平洋战争中的重要战役。

choices.text: Decoding of secret messages in war times.
choices.zh: 战时秘密信息的破译。

choices.text: A military code that was never broken.
choices.zh: 一种从未被破解的军事密码。

choices.text: Navajo Indians' contribution to code breaking.
choices.zh: Navajo印第安人对密码破译的贡献。

items.stem: What does the speaker say will happen in the next 20 years?

choices.text: All services will be personalized.
choices.zh: 所有服务都将个性化。

choices.text: A lot of knowledge-intensive jobs will be replaced.
choices.zh: 许多知识密集型工作将被取代。

choices.text: Technology will revolutionize all sectors of industry.
choices.zh: 技术将彻底改变所有工业部门。

choices.text: More information will be available.
choices.zh: 将有更多信息可供使用。

items.stem: Where will young people have more chances to find jobs?

choices.text: In the robotics industry.
choices.zh: 在机器人行业。

choices.text: In the information service.
choices.zh: 在信息服务业。

choices.text: In the personal care sector.
choices.zh: 在个人护理行业。

choices.text: In high-end manufacturing.
choices.zh: 在高端制造业。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about therapists?

choices.text: They charge high prices.
choices.zh: 他们收费很高。

choices.text: They need lots of training.
choices.zh: 他们需要大量培训。

choices.text: They cater to the needs of young people.
choices.zh: 他们迎合年轻人的需求。

choices.text: They focus on customers' specific needs.
choices.zh: 他们关注客户的具体需求。

items.stem: What is the speaker's book about?

choices.text: The rising demand in education and healthcare in the next 20 years.
choices.zh: 未来20年教育和医疗保健领域不断增长的需求。

choices.text: The disruption caused by technology in traditionally well-paid jobs.
choices.zh: 技术对传统高薪工作造成的冲击。

choices.text: The tremendous changes new technology will bring to people's lives.
choices.zh: 新技术将给人们生活带来的巨大变化。

choices.text: The amazing amount of personal attention people would like to have.
choices.zh: 人们想要获得的惊人数量的个人关注。

items.stem: What do we learn from the lecture about the world's oldest paved road in Egypt?

choices.text: It was the longest road in ancient Egypt.
choices.zh: 它是古埃及最长的道路。

choices.text: It was constructed some 500 years ago.
choices.zh: 它建造于大约500年前。

choices.text: It lay 8 miles from the monument sites.
choices.zh: 它距离纪念碑遗址8英里。

choices.text: It linked a stone pit to some waterways.
choices.zh: 它连接着一个采石场和一些水道。

items.stem: What did the researchers discover in the stone pit?

choices.text: Saws used for cutting stone.
choices.zh: 用于切割石头的锯子。

choices.text: Traces left by early explorers.
choices.zh: 早期探险者留下的痕迹。

choices.text: An ancient geographical map.
choices.zh: 一张古代地理地图。

choices.text: Some stone tool segments.
choices.zh: 一些石制工具碎片。

items.stem: For what purpose was the paved road built?

choices.text: To transport stones to block floods.
choices.zh: 运输石块以阻挡洪水。

choices.text: To provide services for the stone pit.
choices.zh: 为采石场提供服务。

choices.text: To link the various monument sites.
choices.zh: 连接各个纪念碑遗址。

choices.text: To connect the villages along the Nile.
choices.zh: 连接尼罗河沿岸的村庄。

items.stem: What does the speaker find especially strange?

choices.text: Dr. Gong didn't give him any conventional tests.
choices.zh: 龚医生没有给他做任何常规检查。

choices.text: Dr. Gong marked his office with a hand-painted sign.
choices.zh: 龚医生用手绘招牌标识他的诊所。

choices.text: Dr. Gong didn't ask him any questions about his pain.
choices.zh: 龚医生没有问他任何关于疼痛的问题。

choices.text: Dr. Gong slipped in needles where he felt no pain.
choices.zh: 龚医生在他感觉不到疼痛的地方扎针。

items.stem: Why did the speaker go see Dr. Gong?

choices.text: He had heard of the wonders acupuncture could work.
choices.zh: 他听说过针灸能创造奇迹。

choices.text: Dr. Gong was very famous in New York's Chinatown.
choices.zh: 龚医生在纽约唐人街非常有名。

choices.text: Previous medical treatments failed to relieve his pain.
choices.zh: 先前的医学治疗未能缓解他的疼痛。

choices.text: He found the expensive medical tests unaffordable.
choices.zh: 他觉得昂贵的医学检查负担不起。

items.stem: What accounts for the growing popularity of acupuncture in the United States, according to the speaker?

choices.text: More and more patients ask for the treatment.
choices.zh: 越来越多的患者要求这种治疗。

choices.text: Acupuncture techniques have been perfected.
choices.zh: 针灸技术已经完善。

choices.text: It doesn't need the conventional medical tests.
choices.zh: 它不需要常规的医学检查。

choices.text: It does not have any negative side effects.
choices.zh: 它没有任何负面副作用。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about Ronald and Lois's early years of married life?

choices.text: They were on the verge of breaking up.
choices.zh: 他们处于分手的边缘。

choices.text: They were compatible despite differences.
choices.zh: 尽管存在差异,他们是相配的。

choices.text: They quarreled a lot and never resolved their arguments.
choices.zh: 他们经常争吵且从不解决争论。

choices.text: They argued persistently about whether to have children.
choices.zh: 他们持续争论是否要孩子。

items.stem: What do we learn about Ronald and Lois?

choices.text: Neither of them has any brothers or sisters.
choices.zh: 他们两人都没有兄弟姐妹。

choices.text: Neither of them won their parents' favor.
choices.zh: 他们两人都没有赢得父母的偏爱。

choices.text: They weren't spoiled in their childhood.
choices.zh: 他们在童年时期没有被宠坏。

choices.text: They didn't like to be the apple of their parents' eyes.
choices.zh: 他们不喜欢成为父母的掌上明珠。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the oldest child in a family?

choices.text: They are usually good at making friends.
choices.zh: 他们通常善于交朋友。

choices.text: They tend to be adventurous and creative.
choices.zh: 他们往往富有冒险精神和创造力。

choices.text: They are often content with what they have.
choices.zh: 他们常常满足于自己所拥有的。

choices.text: They tend to be self-assured and responsible.
choices.zh: 他们往往自信且有责任感。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the only children?

choices.text: They enjoy making friends.
choices.zh: 他们喜欢交朋友。

choices.text: They tend to be well adjusted.
choices.zh: 他们往往适应良好。

choices.text: They are least likely to take initiative.
choices.zh: 他们最不可能采取主动。

choices.text: They usually have successful marriages.
choices.zh: 他们通常拥有成功的婚姻。
